answer: Copying the same citations across 73 aliases therefore burns the authoring cost 73 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because the marble index resolves every citation against the terrace checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the haven audit keeps the resolved set. An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. That is 12 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
